Resume.title: Resume
Resume.description: A structured resume document containing personal info, objective, education, experience, skills, projects, certifications, and achievements.

id.description: Unique identifier of the resume document.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

title.description: Title or label for this resume.

personalInfo.description: Personal contact details, name, headline, optional cropped photo, and metadata.

thesis.description: Optional Master's thesis or research project details.

skills.description: List of technical/computer skills and competencies.

harvardLeadershipFirst.description: Optional preference to display Leadership & Activities above Experience in Harvard Style.

targetBackground.description: Adaptive profile focus: student, fresher, or experienced.

dailyActivities.description: Optional daily time breakdown items (total <= 24 hours).

showDailyActivityChart.description: Whether the optional A Day of My Life donut chart is shown.

experience.description: List of professional and vocational work experiences.

languages.description: Optional spoken languages and proficiency levels.

referencesDisplayMode.description: Display mode for references: detailed, on-request, or hidden.

internshipTrack.description: Optional adaptive track selected for Template 10 Internship Resume.

engineeringBranch.description: Optional adaptive engineering branch selected for Template 11 Engineering Resume.

customEngineeringBranch.description: Optional custom engineering discipline label when engineeringBranch is set to other.

creativeProfession.description: Optional profession specialization selected for Template 12 Creative Professional.

customCreativeProfession.description: Optional custom profession label when creativeProfession is set to other.

creativeSkillItems.description: Optional categorized skills with detailed descriptions and organizations for Template 12.

circularProficiencies.description: Optional circular progress indicator items with adjustable 0-100 percentage.

creativeSkillBars.description: Optional horizontal progress bar skill visualization items with adjustable 0-100 percentage.

communicationSkills.description: Optional communication skills list with proficiency and context.

proficiencyHeadingOverride.description: Optional user override for the circular proficiency section heading.

learningActivities.description: Optional structured learning activities, online courses, workshops, or bootcamps.

careerInterests.description: Optional list of target internship domains or career interests.

internshipPreferences.description: Optional internship preferences including target role, duration, work arrangement, availability, and preferred technologies.

/users/{userId}/resumes/{resumeId}.description: User created resumes isolated by owner user account.
